_note: L1 elements of concept A (Battle Below the Mountain Gate), picked by David 2026-11-17 04:55 UTC. Base 580 x 580 mm = four 290 x 290 tiles (A2L). Figures ~15 mm. Routes: generate = Tripo image_to_model v3.1 untextured (detailed 40, standard 20); model = Blender structure only (ground slab, tabs, seats). crop = box in the 1536 x 1024 concept. Per decision 1 (sell, ip none): statues are generic armoured warrior-kings, the ruins are a generic burned stone hamlet (no stilt lake-town), no Tolkien names.

elements.desc: a jagged snow-dusted rocky mountain massif with layered crags, pine-dotted lower slopes and a waterfall pouring down its right flank, with a flat recessed niche in the middle of its foot where a gate will sit
elements.note: spans both back tiles; cut at the tile seam x=0 with tabs

elements.desc: a colossal carved stone gateway: a tall pointed arch with heavy carved doorframe and rune bands, flanked by two huge standing statues of armoured bearded warrior-kings holding long swords point-down in front of them, all on one stone plinth
a long rocky grassy hill spur with stepped flat-topped ledges for troops to stand on, broken grey rock faces, small pine trees and boulders, sloping down at the front end
elements.note: left spur as is; right spur mirrored and recut

elements.desc: the burned ruins of a small stone hamlet on a rocky shore: a broken round watchtower, roofless stone cottages with collapsed walls, charred beams, rubble, and a short broken wooden jetty
elements.note: front-right tile, beside a carved shoreline

elements.desc: a tight shield-wall regiment of 9 stocky bearded dwarf warriors in heavy plate armour with big round shields locked together in front and axes raised, marching forward on one shared flat rocky base
a charging wedge of 8 stocky bearded dwarf warriors in heavy armour with war hammers and axes and one standard-bearer with a square banner, on one shared flat rocky base
a regiment of 8 tall slender elf archers in leaf-patterned scale armour and long cloaks, in two ranks drawing longbows, with one tall leaf-shaped banner, on one shared flat grassy base

a regiment of 8 tall slender elf warriors in leaf-patterned armour with tall crested helms, long spears held upright close to their bodies and curved leaf-shaped shields, on one shared flat grassy base
a regiment of 9 human soldiers in kettle helmets, mail shirts and tabards, holding long spears levelled forward in a tight phalanx behind kite shields, on one shared flat base
a regiment of 8 human soldiers in kettle helmets and long tabards with swords and round shields, one carrying a tall pennant banner, advancing on one shared flat base
a disorderly charging mob of 10 hunched, wiry goblins with big ears, crude spiked iron helmets, jagged scimitars and crude spiked round shields, mouths open screaming, on one shared rough dirt base
a mob of 9 hunched goblins with crude spears and cleavers, ragged hide armour, one carrying a tattered black banner on a crooked pole, running forward on one shared rough dirt base
a mob of 8 hunched goblins fighting: some swinging axes overhead, some with crude bows, two dragging a dead comrade, broken spears on the ground, on one shared rough dirt base
a single giant eagle diving with wings spread wide and swept back, talons thrust forward to strike, feathers sculpted in layers
a single giant eagle braking in mid-air with wings raised high and fully spread, talons open and reaching down, head forward, feathers sculpted in layers
a cluster of four solid stylised pine trees of different heights growing from one small rocky base, chunky printable foliage tiers
a solid billowing smoke column rising from a burning pile of timber with sculpted flames at its base, the plume a thick twisting solid mass
four tiles: valley floor with a gentle rise to the gate, shoreline cut on the front-right, sockets for every regiment and the eagle rods, tabs 4.0/4.2 at the seams

a square slab of trampled battlefield ground in very low relief: packed earth with grass tufts, scattered boulders and small rocks, broken spears and arrows lying flat, a few dropped round shields, churned mud and a worn dirt track crossing it; the whole slab no taller than one tenth of its width
elements.note: added 2026-11-17 at David's go-ahead; copies (rotated, mirrored) cover the valley floor between regiments
